name: Pro Football Archives — the ROSTER table on a club-season page
acquisition: the pages were already held: 1,446 in pgm3-sources/pfa-team-seasons fetched 2026-09-08, plus pfa2, pfa and pfa-awards. 21 more fetched 2026-09-09 at one request per second from a list enumerated off the club table BEFORE any request, with 4 absences recorded.
rights: profootballarchives.com. Held for consultation and citation, not republished. Every claim names the page.
_why_this_is_a_separate_source_id: `pro-football-archives` already covers the SEASON STATISTIC tables on these same pages. The roster table sits above them and had never been read. Splitting the id means a reader can see which part of the page a fact came from, and it means the 9-cited figure that should have been an alarm cannot hide behind a large one.
_the_fourth_instance: The drafts, the box scores, the 1,469 team-season pages, and now the ROSTERS ON THOSE SAME PAGES. Every one is a section read for one purpose and not another. declarations/source-coverage.json recorded team-seasons as 2,930 cached and 9 cited and nothing treated that as an alarm.
_what_a_roster_table_carries: Player, No, Pos, Ht, Wt, Age, College, GP, GS -- four of the four facts the hunting instrument counts.
_the_title_is_the_test: A page carrying a roster is titled `<year> <club> (<league>) Scores, Roster, Stats, Coaches`; one without is titled `<year> <club> (<league>) - Pro Football Archives`. Measured across 2,404 cached pages: ONE promises a roster and has none (1941afany.html) and SIX have one without promising it, all 1938 pages in an older title format. 99.7% and the exceptions are named.
_scope: Ryan's ruling names 414 pages and 16,422 men: the club-seasons PFA is the only source for, plus any the archive holds NOBODY on. Reading every club-season page instead would place 106,539 men and write 956,315 claims, almost all of it restating rosters already held from nflverse and StatsCrew -- the trap the cell-shaped gamelog ingest was ruled against the same day. The whole-corpus figure is measured and reported; it is not written.
_the_join: Exact name on the club-season, then surname and forename initial held TO the club-season, then nothing. TIER 2 -- exact and unique anywhere in the archive -- IS NOT TRIED: it is inadmissible for a club-season placement, and these are 1930s and 1940s men with common names. Every claim records the tier that placed it.
_nobody_is_promoted: A man who matches nothing is a LEAD carrying its roster line and its no-match evidence. Admitting a person is its own act, and promote_players.py already accepts `printed_roster` under Ryan's ruling of 2026-09-09.
_two_name_problems_kept_apart: A source's TYPO and a source's ALTERNATIVE NAME are different things. Three typos are declared by Ryan -- Lousville/Louisville, Chiuefs/Chiefs, Benagls/Bengals -- where the archive holds PFA's own misspelling off its standings pages and PFA's team page spells it right. The rest are classified BY SHAPE with the basis recorded on the claim: `set differently` (the same letters spaced otherwise), `typo by shape: N letters apart` with the distance, and `a second name one source prints for one club` -- Charlotte Bantams against Charlotte Purols, the Newark Bears and Demons shape. NO SECOND CLUB IS CREATED and nothing is renamed; both stand. Edit distance finds typos and structurally cannot find a second printed name, so a small distance is REPORTED as a shape and never asserted as a correction.
_the_coaches: The page prints `Head Coach: <name>` and the archive is thin on staff for these leagues. Taken as `pfa.head_coach_as_printed` on the club-season, as printed, joined to nobody.
